contracts.name: native_a2a_client_sdk_contract
contracts.direction: xMind native outbound client -> independent official SDK 1.3.0 server peer
scope: reject missing bearer credentials
discover authenticated AgentCard
SendMessage and GetTask
preserve an SDK-produced text artifact
consume wrapped task/statusUpdate SendStreamingMessage events
CancelTask

contracts.name: native_a2a_v1_http_contract
contracts.direction: independent official SDK 1.3.0 client -> xMind native server
scope: official SDK discovery, send, get, list, cancel, stream and subscribe
A2A 1.0 and supported 0.3 compatibility wire
task history and cross-version retry persistence through SQLite restart
text and structured-data part/metadata preservation
current and legacy inline UTF-8 text file parts
same-context terminal referenceTaskIds
rejection of malformed, binary, unsupported-media and remote-URL file parts
native AgentRunner reaches an independent synthetic provider endpoint

contracts.name: native_a2a_agent_registry_contract
contracts.direction: xMind native AgentRunner -> registered synthetic A2A peer
scope: registered peer metadata and bearer credential stored through xlang3-backed SQLite
typed agent tool discovery and approval bound to exact peer revision and prompt
actual native remote dispatch and streaming event journaling
denial without peer dispatch
post-dispatch uncertainty, SQLite reopen inspection and resubscription without send replay
owner-authenticated registry APIs and same-origin local view access

limitations: Peer and provider behavior is test-fixture behavior; this is not a live external service or model acceptance.
JSON-RPC HTTP is the tested binding; this does not establish every transport, security scheme, MIME type, or A2A 1.0.1 requirement.
This does not establish installed VS Code or browser-rendered A2A workflows, nor full product parity.
